root_idea.summary: The supplied evidence centers the root on introducing a distinguishing variation or ornament into a surface or expression, while also preserving a separately reported branch of increase and fertility.
root_idea.development: Concrete variegation or figuring of cloth yields the noun for a contrasting colour-mark and the figurative use for embellished or distorted speech. A separate line of increase, prolific reproduction, and abundance is also reported, but it is not assigned to the supplied Quranic noun.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular noun citation form شِيَةٌ.

senses.definition: A patch or mark of colour differing from the predominant colour; a contrasting colour-mark or blemish.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction لَا شِيَةَ فِيهَا, it denotes the absence of such a contrasting mark in the described object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To variegate or figure cloth or a garment, to embellish it, or to mark a thing with a contrasting trace.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Concrete use concerning surface coloration, ornamentation, or patterned marking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To embellish or distort speech, including by lying; with بِهِ, to carry tales about, calumniate, or misrepresent someone to an authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The speech use is figurative, based on the ornamentation or patterning of cloth; the construction وَشَى بِهِ refers to the person reported against or misrepresented.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of variegated or figured cloth or garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun for the decorated textile itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Variegation, figured work, or the making of something parti-coloured; also a natural diversity of colours.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract or process noun for patterned or contrasting coloration.
A figurative designation for one who conveys reports or tales.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mark, sign, symptom, or token by which a thing is known.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader identifying-mark use, distinct from the specifically contrasting-colour sense attested in the Quranic occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A saying that has been misrepresented.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction قَوْلٌ مَوْشِيٌّ بِهِ.
A specialized lexical use attributed to an archaic poetic usage.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Calumniating or misrepresenting someone to authority.

cautions: The contextual rendering “blemish” is compatible with the Quranic usage, but the lexical evidence specifically emphasizes a contrasting colour-mark and does not by itself require a moral sense.
The Quran occurrence شِيَةَ is presented under the normalized citation form شِيَةٌ.
